final: SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id as atom_id FROM connected c WHERE c.bond_id IN (SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=' AND molecule_id = 'TR012') AND c.atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'c' AND molecule_id = 'TR012') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id2 as atom_id FROM connected c WHERE c.bond_id IN (SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=' AND molecule_id = 'TR012') AND c.atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'c' AND molecule_id = 'TR012') ORDER BY atom_id
